svg.text: How our model works: the real/bogus CNN
Asteroid Hunter · ZTF difference images · one small convolutional neural network decides if a blob is a real moving object
WHERE THIS MODEL SITS IN THE WHOLE PIPELINE
72,145 learnable weights · trained on 53,178 stamps · average precision 0.899 (validation) and 0.938 (untouched test night) · baseline 0.780
